title.narrative: Support to the Mandate Implementation of Special Envoy of the Secretary-General on Myanmar

description.narrative: The objective of the development cooperation is to support the mandate delivery of the Special Envoy, with specific focus on building the capacity of the Inclusive Humanitarian Forum (IHF) conveners and associated actors to enable increased humanitarian assistance to the most vulnerable through all channels and save lives. The activities are as follows: - Increasing the delivery of humanitarian assistance in Myanmar to the most vulnerable through all channels - Increased coordinated action among ASEAN and key Member States in support of a Myanmar-led peace process. - Increased inclusion of women, youth, and vulnerable groups in dialogue processes and public messaging on Myanmar’s future.
